competing_hypotheses.H1_purification: guided replaces each band pixel with its own token class's local RGB mean; at 10,204 of 12,196 errors the stored token equals GT, so purification can fix up to 10,204 and can harm up to 1,992. If collateral is small, guided wins large.
competing_hypotheses.H2_collateral: the same operator perturbs 2,287,200 already-correct scored-plane edge pixels by a mean of 27 of 255 RGB levels. A harm rate of only 0.5% on those is 11,436 new errors, which dominates any benefit. Under H2 the net d_seg is WORSE and the family closes.

predictions_registered: sign(delta_d_seg) is ordered by intervention amplitude: sdf least harmful, then ssaa, then guided, then composition.
benefit < harm for guided and composition (H2 dominates) with probability the author judges high but does not assert as measured.
d_pose worsens monotonically with amplitude for every mode, because PoseNet reads the treated frame_1 of every pair.
no treatment is inert: every mode changes at least 18,000 camera pixels per frame, so a null result would itself be a finding.
falsifier_of_the_whole_family: If every mode has 100*delta_d_seg + 0.205*delta_pose_sse >= -2e-5 at n600, the FREE post-render boundary treatment family is closed at formulation scope on this vehicle, because the free receiver cannot identify which 0.53% of its edge pixels are wrong (strict-scorer rule forbids a scorer in the receiver), so it must act on all of them.
